best_num, best_den = 0, 1
i = 1
while i <= n:
    temp = (x * i) // y
    diff1 = x * i - temp * y
    diff2 = (temp + 1) * y - x * i
    if diff1 > diff2:
        temp += 1
    left = best_den * (x * i - temp * y)
    right = i * (x * best_den - y * best_num)
    if left * left < right * right:
        best_num = temp
        best_den = i
    i += 1
print(f"{best_num}/{best_den}")
